speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; please tell me, were there any complications during pregnancy or delivery, such as prematurity or difficulty breathing at birth? 

REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas, Complete_Blood_Count, Blood_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal blood work results. Since the initial labs are unremarkable, have you noticed any specific signs like cyanosis, grunting, or nasal flaring, and was there a family history of genetic conditions or respiratory issues?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity and maternal gestational diabetes.
